notes: Feature 3 implements the Script Node MV world-description input/output interaction and API contract only.
The current Script Node input is a single AI chat-style world-view description.
The Script Node output expands that description into storyboard direction, character profiles, and concrete scene descriptions.
The current Script Node editor shows the agent response above the input, keeps Storyboard/Characters/Scene selection in the Generate-row dropdown, and supports drag, resize, close, and reopen.
Prompt wording is intentionally centralized and adjustable later without changing route or UI contracts.
Real provider credentials are supplied through environment variables; mock provider remains the default verification path.
Storyboards as a separate editable node remain Feature 4.

small_features.title: Define shared Script Node contracts
small_features.user_visible_behavior: The Script Node has stable typed world-description input, structured output, task, and status shapes used by frontend and backend-facing code.
acceptance_criteria: Script input includes only world_description for the first MV world-view prompt.
Script output includes title, world_overview, storyboard_direction with POV and shots, characters with visual/wardrobe/body details, scene_descriptions, and missing_inputs.
Task status values remain compatible with the repository API contract.
verification: Run shared/web tests that consume Script Node contracts.

small_features.title: Implement FastAPI Script Node API and mock provider
small_features.user_visible_behavior: The Script Node can save input, create a generation task, and retrieve structured output through backend API routes.
acceptance_criteria: PATCH /api/v1/projects/{project_id}/nodes/{node_id} saves Script Node input and settings.
POST /api/v1/projects/{project_id}/nodes/{node_id}/run returns a task response and produces validated structured output through the mock provider.
GET /api/v1/tasks/{task_id} and GET /api/v1/tasks/{task_id}/result return task status and normalized Script Node output.
Non-mock provider configuration fails clearly when required env values are missing.
verification: Run backend pytest for validation, save, run, result, mock output, and missing provider config.

small_features.title: Implement workspace Script Node editor
small_features.user_visible_behavior: Selecting the Script node opens an editor where users can enter an MV world prompt through the AI chat UI, run generation, and review structured results.
acceptance_criteria: The editor is reachable from the selected Script node in /workspace.
The editor includes one required AI chat-style MV world description input.
Run action saves input, starts generation through the Script Node API client, shows task state, and renders selectable Storyboard, Characters, and Scene response targets.
Output target selection is in the dropdown immediately left of Generate and shows only Storyboard, Characters, and Scene names.
The response area appears above the input in a ChatGPT-like layout and does not use a separate Choose output card.
The Script Node editor can be dragged, resized, closed, and reopened by clicking the Script node.
The Script node status changes to ready only after validated output exists.
Image, audio, video, persistence, and production auth gaps remain honestly labeled.
verification: Run desktop Browser QA for input to generated output flow.

small_features.title: Record Feature 3 evidence and closure
small_features.user_visible_behavior: Feature status, sprint evidence, evaluator score, and progress logs show exactly what passed and what remains deferred.
acceptance_criteria: feature_list.json records Feature 3 passing only after implementation and verification evidence exist.
sprint-contract.md records scope, criteria, commands, and outcomes.
evaluator-rubric.md records an evaluation score and revision evidence.
progress.md and session-handoff.md are updated for the next session.
verification: Run JSON validation for feature_list.json and feature_tasks/3.json.
